mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of instances during FEDFUNDS declines below 1.25% (current value 1.3), or IC < 0.05 over 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid inflation spike (CPIAUCSL crossing above 248) signals supply-side pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL does not cross above 248 within the next month, or 20d returns are not negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in economic demand (GDPC1) and monetary easing (FEDFUNDS decline) creates a favorable dual signal, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction effect (GDPC1 and FEDFUNDS) has IC <0.05 over 20d window, or returns not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a drop in business demand (RSAFS) below 500 signals peak demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Not in late-cycle expansion regime (e.g., GDP growth >2%), or 20d returns not negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in unemployment (UNRATE crossing above 4.5%) signals labor market weakening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not cross above 4.5% within the next month, or returns not negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO below 105.5) indicates supply-side constraints, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO remains above 105.5 for >50% of the 60d window, or 60d returns not positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor demand (PAYEMS >150k) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE <4.0%) creates a labor market expansion signal, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Combined effect of PAYEMS >150k and UNRATE <4.0% occurs <30% of the time, or 5d returns not positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery, a drop in economic demand (GDPC1 below 17000) signals renewed growth potential, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Not in post-shock recovery regime (e.g., GDP growth >-1%), or 60d returns not positive (p>0.05).
